test_camofox_navigate: test the camofox_navigate function to create a browser tab and navigate to a URL with task_id tracking
test_camofox_snapshot: test the camofox_snapshot function to retrieve an accessibility tree snapshot from an active browser session
test_camofox_click: test the camofox_click function to click a page element by its accessibility reference identifier
test_camofox_vision: test the camofox_vision function to capture a screenshot and analyze it with an LLM using configurable temperature and timeout
test_camofox_mode: test the is_camofox_mode and check_camofox_available functions to verify Camofox browser backend detection and health check
